title: MPE Project Memory — measured relief, bounded scope

scenes.headline: Stop rediscovering settled decisions
facts: EXP-15 compared a baseline and a bounded memory prototype across four completed MPE tasks.
The baseline recorded 17 document reads and 1,838 lines of context.

scenes.headline: Memory, without a second source of truth
facts: The experiment used a bounded, file-backed, provenance-aware memory prototype.
Git remained canonical; writes were approval-gated; no production service or code was added.

scenes.headline: Less context. Fewer rediscovery steps.
facts: Context fell from 1,838 to 104 lines (94.3%); rediscovery steps fell from 21 to 4 (81.0%).
Prior decisions were recalled correctly on all four benchmark tasks.

scenes.headline: Guardrails held; the result stays bounded
facts: All six acceptance checks passed; unauthorized writes and cross-project leakage were both zero.
EXP-15 reported PASS. Its evidence covers four tasks; it is not production validation.
